decision.interpretation: Large bold font (17.2pt) at top of page; forms first line of the document title introducing the specification.
Large bold font (17.2pt) directly below title line; forms second line of the document title introducing the specification.
Larger bold font (14.4pt) positioned above summary paragraph; introduces the abstract section at its location.
Larger bold font (14.4pt) positioned above legal text; introduces the status section at its location.
Larger bold font (14.4pt) positioned above copyright text; introduces the copyright notice section at its location.
